samples.response: Metallskeden har en högre termisk ledningsförmåga än träskeden, vilket gör att värmeenergi kan överföras snabbare och effektivt. Detta innebär att metallskeden kan kännas kallare, även om de har samma temperatur.

limitations: Version 0.1 is an author-reviewed public pilot, not a population-valid national benchmark.
The small sample sizes produce wide uncertainty intervals and are intended for harness validation and early model profiling.
Open-generation scores depend on the selected judge and should be calibrated against native-speaker human ratings.
The pilot is text-only and does not yet measure speech, vision or interactive multi-step agents.
The bundled suite is public and may be present in model training data.
The target ran from the official BF16 Transformers checkpoint on Apple MPS; it was not an Ollama/GGUF quantization.
The 31.3B local Gemma judge ran after target generation from preserved responses and has not yet been calibrated against native-speaker Swedish ratings, so judged scores are provisional.
SVEA uses short prompts and does not evaluate this checkpoint's 256K-context capability.

rescoring_history.reason: SVEA Core v0.1.2 enforces the explicit single-letter response contract on multiple-choice items. Saved model responses and judge outputs were reused; surrounding option text is now marked malformed and receives zero.

SVEA Core v0.1.3 awards 0.5 semantic partial credit when a malformed multiple-choice response begins with an unambiguous correct choice. Full credit and passed status still require exactly one letter; saved model responses and judge outputs were reused.
